BSc Physics core (constructed test document, fictional)

Year 1
PHYS1001 Mechanics (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: None
  Assessment: 4 assignments, 1 midterm, 1 final exam
PHYS1002 Waves and Optics (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: None
  Assessment: 3 assignments, 1 final exam
MATH1001 Calculus (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: None
  Assessment: 5 quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final exam
MATH1002 Linear Algebra (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: None
  Assessment: 4 assignments, 1 final exam

Year 2
PHYS2001 Electromagnetism (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS1001 and MATH1001
  Assessment: 4 assignments, 1 midterm, 1 final exam
PHYS2002 Thermal Physics (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS1001
  Assessment: 3 assignments, 1 final exam
PHYS2003 Computational Physics (3 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS1002 and MATH1002
  Assessment: 2 projects

Year 3
PHYS3001 Quantum Mechanics (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS2001 and MATH1002
  Assessment: 5 assignments, 1 midterm, 1 final exam
PHYS3002 Statistical Mechanics (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS2002 and PHYS3001
  Assessment: 4 assignments, 1 final exam
PHYS3003 Research Project (6 credits)
  Prerequisite: PHYS2003
  Assessment: 1 proposal, 1 report, 1 presentation
